title: Commutation Groups and State-Independent Contextuality
summary: We introduce an algebraic structure for studying state-independent contextuality arguments, a key form of quantum non-classicality exemplified by the well-known Peres-Mermin magic square, and used as a source of quantum advantage. We introduce \emph{commutation groups} presented by generators and relations, and analyse them in terms of a string rewriting system. There is also a linear algebraic construction, a directed version of the Heisenberg group. We introduce \emph{contextual words} as a general form of contextuality witness.
